#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

ll mod_pow(ll a, ll e, ll m) {
    ll r = 1;
    while (e--) r = (r * a) % m;
    return r;
}

struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent, sz;
    DSU(int n) {
        parent.resize(n);
        sz.assign(n, 1);
        iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    }
    int find(int x) {
        while (parent[x] != x) {
            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]];
            x = parent[x];
        }
        return x;
    }
    void unite(int a, int b) {
        a = find(a);
        b = find(b);
        if (a == b) return;
        if (sz[a] < sz[b]) swap(a, b);
        parent[b] = a;
        sz[a] += sz[b];
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << mod_pow(n, n - 1, MOD);
        return 0;
    }

    DSU dsu(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        dsu.unite(i, int((1LL * i * k) % n));
    }

    ll ans = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (dsu.find(i) != i) continue;
        if (mod_pow(k, dsu.sz[i], n) == 1) {
            ans = (ans * n) % MOD;
        }
    }

    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
